assumptions.statement: Official polygons for the overall design area and the three key detailed-design areas are unavailable; PROV-SITE-001 and PROV-KEY-001/002/003 remain provisional rough constraints only.
assumptions.recalculation_trigger: Receipt of official or user-cleared site and key-area polygons with a verifiable coordinate reference system.

assumptions.statement: Approved floor area ratio controls and verified total floor area are unknown; no FAR value may be presented as an approved planning control.
assumptions.recalculation_trigger: Receipt of approved regulatory controls, parcel geometry, and verified floor-area data.

assumptions.statement: Approved building-height controls and verified existing building heights are unknown; all future massing and skyline media remain design proposals.
assumptions.recalculation_trigger: Receipt of approved height controls, heritage view-corridor constraints, and a verified existing-building survey.

assumptions.statement: Parcel boundaries, land ownership, tenure, and implementation authority are unknown; phasing and project packaging cannot imply consent or delivery commitment.
assumptions.recalculation_trigger: Receipt of cleared cadastral parcels, ownership or tenure records, and confirmed implementation responsibilities.

assumptions.statement: Existing and planned utility alignments, spare capacity, drainage, power, gas, fire access, flood control, and related engineering constraints are unknown.
assumptions.recalculation_trigger: Receipt of verified municipal utility, drainage, power, gas, fire-safety, and flood-control surveys plus professional capacity review.

assumptions.statement: Metrics derived from provisional polygons are reproducible design-discussion values, not precise official areas or formal planning controls.
assumptions.recalculation_trigger: Any replacement or revision of PROV-SITE-001, PROV-KEY-001/002/003, or a downstream design geometry.

assumptions.statement: AI-native scenarios are conceptual service designs; privacy, data minimization, security, accessibility, human fallback, complaint handling, and accountable human review require scenario-specific validation before deployment.
assumptions.recalculation_trigger: Scenario-specific legal, privacy, security, accessibility, operational, and accountable-human review before pilot procurement or deployment.

assumptions.statement: Illustrations, diagrams, rendered views, and audiovisual concepts communicate design intent only and do not evidence existing conditions, approved geometry, engineering feasibility, or implementation commitment.
assumptions.recalculation_trigger: Replacement with surveyed, licensed, source-registered, and professionally reviewed media or drawings.

assumptions.statement: Six public institutional or academic case-study pages are registered for method-level background comparison only; they do not evidence local conditions, statutory controls, implementation commitments, or rights to reuse third-party assets.
assumptions.recalculation_trigger: Recheck URLs, factual summaries, public availability, and reuse limitations before any later publication or material reuse.
